commands.about: The player calls out a body part on the target to destroy.

commands.name: Finger Lock

commands.name: Gutbuster

commands.name: Headlock
commands.about: On a successful attack, the fighter grabs the target about the neck from behind in a headlock.

commands.name: Stance
commands.about: During combat, the fighter takes on one of the fighting stances he or she has been trained in.

commands.name: Sweep
commands.about: Allows the fighter wielding a slashing weapon to rear back and take a free whack at all opponents within range.

commands.name: Sweeping Trip
commands.about: Allows the fighter wielding a melee weapon with range to sweep low at all opponents within range, potentially tripping them.

commands.name: Tend Mount
commands.about: The character uses his knowledge of mount creatures, especially those favored or racial mounts, to attempt to heal them of poisons, diseases, bleeding, and other damage.

commands.name: Tumble
commands.about: Allows the fighter to avoid a couple of potentially painful hits in combat by tumbling around.

commands.name: Unwavering Mark
commands.about: This skill allows the fighter to issue a powerful challenge to the target, infuriating them.

commands.name: Vanguard
commands.about: The fighter volunteers to be a mounted vanguard for the given wagon or caravan.

commands.name: War Cry
commands.about: The Barbarian lets out a primal call to war, inspiring all group members to follow his or her banner.

commands.name: Weapon Break
commands.about: The fighter will attempt the difficult maneuver of breaking the weapon of the target.

commands.name: Weapon Sharpening
commands.about: The fighter sharpens the slashing or piercing weapon so that it will give a slight damage bonus during use.

commands.name: Whomp
commands.about: The fighter attempts to deliver a massive blow to the target, causing them to instantly to fall unconscious for a time.

commands.name: Wrist Lock
commands.about: The fighter grabs ahold of his enemyï¿½s hand, immobilizing them.

commands.name: Age
commands.about: Every character has an age.

commands.name: Amputation
commands.about: This ability governs the careful removal of body parts as a punishment for crimes, or from corpses.

commands.name: Bleeding
commands.about: Bleeding is when there are open wounds from which the fluid of life runs freely.

commands.name: Blessing
commands.about: The character bestows a mundane blessing upon the target.

commands.name: Broken Limbs
commands.about: This ability governs the careful breaking of body parts as a punishment for crimes.

commands.name: Combat Frenzy
commands.about: This ability allows one to enter a state of blind combative frenzy.

commands.name: Dragonbreath
commands.about: Ability : Dragonbreath Parameters : acid/fire/cold/lightning/gas/dust/ Parameters : pebbles/ooze/undead/slime (lesser) Description: Gives the creature the ability to use his or her breath weapon.

commands.name: Food Begging
commands.about: This skill allows the character to begin making cute faces at the target, compelling them to give up any food they might have.

commands.name: Hamstring
commands.about: This brutal skill allows the player to lash out at the enemy`s leg, attempting to severe crucial tendons.

commands.name: Pregnancy
commands.about: For direct REMORTING, if your mud supports it, please see help on the REMORT command.

commands.name: Quick Swipe
commands.about: The thief will attempt to take a random small worn item, or a bit of shiny money from the target, and then immediately flee.

commands.name: Quills
commands.about: Being covered in sharp quills, this ability will automatically harm an attacker who gets in range.

commands.name: Scavenge
commands.about: With this skill, a dead body can be scavanged for parts, especially the last bits of meat.

commands.name: Shoot Web
commands.about: This spell will cause a glob of sticky web-like material to assault the target.

commands.name: Soiled
commands.about: Being dirty and smelly.

commands.name: Throw Feces
commands.about: The player with this skill is able to reach around and produce feces on demand and then instantly throw it at the target.

commands.name: Cold Touch
commands.about: Ability : Undead_ColdTouch Parameters : Description: An attack which, if successful, gives the target a strength and constitution of 3.

commands.name: Energy Drain
commands.about: Ability : Undead_EnergyDrain Parameters : Description: An attack which, if successful, drains the target of temporary levels.

commands.name: Drain Life
commands.about: Ability : Undead_LifeDrain Parameters : Description: An attack that is almost identical to the mage Drain spell, without the magical nature.

commands.name: Weak Energy Drain
commands.about: Ability : Undead_WeakEnergyDrain Parameters : Description: An attack which, if successful, drains the target of temporary levels for a short time.

commands.name: Wild Tag Turf
commands.about: The creature tags this place as their "turf" or, if they are a part of a clan, their clan's "turf".

commands.name: Winged Flight
commands.about: Ability : WingFlying Parameters : Description: The ability to control winged flight.

commands.name: Breakup Fight
commands.about: If the Paladin is not fighting, he or she may use this skill to break up a fight between any two other creatures or players.

commands.name: Chaos Rage
commands.about: Allows the paladin to gain some temporary bonus hit points, bonus attack points, and bonus damage, at the expense of a slightly lower armor score.

commands.name: Command Horse
commands.about: The Paladin`s affinity with his holy mount has grown such that they have the natural ability to command him to do just about anything he wants.

commands.name: Craft Holy Avenger
commands.about: Allows the Paladin with Weaponsmithing to craft a powerful +5 weapon.

commands.name: Craft Unholy Reaver
commands.about: Allows the Paladin with Weaponsmithing to craft a powerful +5 weapon.

commands.name: All Defence
commands.about: During combat, the Paladin can use this skill to stop attacking in favor of an all-out defensive posture.

commands.name: Healing Hands
commands.about: The Paladin becomes a vessel for the power of his or her god, either healing or harming depending on their heart.

commands.name: Holy Strike
commands.about: Wielding a melee weapon, the paladin calls down the power of his or her god into a mighty attack for devastating damage on evil targets.

commands.name: Incite Fight
commands.about: The Paladin incites the target to aggression, even against neighbors they would normally ignore.

commands.name: Mounted Charge
commands.about: The fighter, from the back of a mount, rides at top speed at a target, delivering a deadly attack, but sacrificing armor.

commands.name: Call Mount
commands.about: Allows the Paladin to call upon a holy steed which can bear him from place to place.

commands.name: Unholy Strike
commands.about: Wielding a melee weapon, the paladin calls down the power of the gods into a mighty attack for devastating damage on good targets.

commands.name: Camouflage
commands.about: The ranger covers the target so that they resemble the surrounding country, making them more difficult to see.

commands.name: Find Water
commands.about: The ranger attempts to find a trail leading from where he or she is at present, to the location of a water source (not necessarily the closest)!

commands.name: Woodland Hide
commands.about: The ranger attempts to creep behind a rock, or into a bush and remain perfectly still.

commands.name: Set Snare
commands.about: The ranger carefully sets a snare on the outdoor room, tripping up and binding anyone who runs into it.

commands.name: Woodland Sneak
commands.about: So long as the Ranger is in the wild, he or she can use this skill to attempt to sneak in the indicated direction.

commands.name: Track
commands.about: The ranger attempts to find a trail leading from where he or she is at present, to the location of the indicated target (not necessarily the closest)!

commands.name: Track Animal
commands.about: The ranger, being a skilled hunter, may use this skill to track down the nearest unintelligent animal in the area.

commands.name: Woodland Creep
commands.about: The ranger creep slowly from bush to tree, remaining especially hard to spot.

commands.name: Abandon Ship
commands.about: During ship combat, the sailor can summon all his or her skill and training into a panicked rush of life-and-property-saving action.

commands.name: Arrest
commands.about: This powerful skill allows the player to automagically knock out the target, and instantly handcuff them for travel to the local judge for trial.

commands.name: Arresting Sap
commands.about: If the target has warrants out in the area, this skill will knock them out so that they can be cuffed for transport to the judge for trial.

commands.name: AutoClimb
commands.about: The player begins climbing around whenever they move.

commands.name: AutoCrawl
commands.about: The player begins crawling around whenever they move.

commands.name: AutoSwim
commands.about: The player begins instinctively using their swimming skill whenever they move.

commands.name: Await Clan Ship
commands.about: While standing on a shore, this skill will cause the sailors nearest big sailing ship belonging to their clan/guild to be sailed to where they are, provided there is no one aboard who could do it…

commands.name: Await Ship
commands.about: While standing on a shore, this skill will cause the sailors nearest big sailing ship to be sailed to where the sailor is.

commands.name: Shield Bash
commands.about: The fighter uses their shield as a weapon, delivering an otherwise additional blow to the target in combat.

commands.name: Bear Foraging
commands.about: This instinctive skill allows the player to sniff out food nearby, even in containers, and even in the possession of others.

commands.name: Befoul Shrine
commands.about: Befouling a shrine makes the infused sacred place unusuable for religious services until it is appropriately cleansed and purified.

commands.name: Buck
commands.about: The centaur, horse or other rideable attempts to buck off all his or her riders off of them.

commands.name: Cage
commands.about: The thief will attempt to get a sleeping or otherwise bound or subdued animal into a cage for safe keeping.

commands.name: Caravan Travel
commands.about: This skill works with the charts created with the Trade Charting skill to find the direction the player must steer their caravan in order to reach a charted location.

commands.name: Chirgury
commands.about: The player is able to remove body parts from the dead, blood from the living or the dead, or an unborn fetus from the living.

commands.name: Climb
commands.about: In some places, one may be able (or required) to climb up or down a surface in order to get there safely.

commands.name: Collect Bounty
commands.about: If the player is able to bring a legitimately wanted criminal up before a judge in the same area, the judge will pay the player a bounty on the criminal and bring in an authorized cityguard to…

commands.name: Combat Log
commands.about: This ability allows the player to assess key statistics about another character or creatures performance in a fight.

commands.name: Combat Recall
commands.about: The player has the ability to perfectly recall fights and combat that he or she witnesses, and can review them at will.

commands.name: Combat Repairs
commands.about: The sailor quickly runs around patching up holes and other ship damage with any materials on hand.

commands.name: Consume Corpse
commands.about: This twisted semi-magical skill causes the mouth of the caster to grow large enough to consume a corpse in one gulp.

commands.name: Control Undead
commands.about: The evil or neutral priest attempts to frighten the heck out of an undead creature.

commands.name: Convert
commands.about: This skill allows Clerics to convert themselves or others to the worship of specific deities.

commands.name: Crow`s Nest
commands.about: Allows the sailor to attempt to climb up into the crows nest from the deck of their large sailing ship.

commands.name: Dead Reckoning
commands.about: From the deck of a boat or ship, the sailor can use their intuition and superior guesswork to determine which direction lies the path to the closest land.

commands.name: Decipher Script
commands.about: The player decodes any encryption on a book or document or other writing.

commands.name: Diary
commands.about: Allows the player to keep a diary of the experiences they witness.

commands.name: Dirt
commands.about: The fighter attempts to kick dirt into the eyes of the target, making them temporarily blind.

commands.name: Disarm
commands.about: The fighter attempts to use his or her weapon to disarm the target, hurling their weapon onto the floor and out of reach.

commands.name: Encrypted Writing
examples: ewrite parchment From recall, go nseeseenwesee
commands.about: Available: ALL This skill allows one to write encrypted messages in common language onto ordinary paper, parchments, and similar writing material.

commands.name: Enslave
commands.about: This skill allows the player to break down an intelligent mob and enslave them.

commands.name: Feint
commands.about: During combat, the player feints a attack in order to put his or her opponent off balance.

commands.name: Find Clan Home
commands.about: The player uses their innate sense of direction to find a trail leading from where he or she is at present, to their clans nearest private property!

commands.name: Find Clan Ship
commands.about: The player uses their innate sense of direction to find a trail leading from where he or she is at present, to their clans nearest private sailing ship!

commands.name: Find Home
commands.about: The player uses their innate sense of direction to find a trail leading from where he or she is at present, to their nearest owned private property!

commands.name: Foul Weather Sailing
commands.about: This skill allows the sailor to rig their ship for sailing in torrential storms and other foul weather, which will eliminate any related sailing problems.

commands.name: Groin
commands.about: The player delivers a dirty rotten kick to the groin, causing the target to take a bit of damage, feel a horrible amount of pain, and for males, to be dazed for a time.

commands.name: Haggle
commands.about: This skill allows the user to get better rates on buying and selling items by haggling with the shopkeeper over the price.

commands.name: Handcuff
commands.about: Allows the player to bind another mob that is sitting or lying down, and force them to follow them around.

commands.name: Hard to Port
commands.about: During combat on a ship, the player can put his ship and rigging at risk by putting the ship into an immediate hard turn to port.

commands.name: Hard to Starboard
commands.about: During combat on a ship, the player can put his ship and rigging at risk by putting the ship into an immediate hard turn to stern.

commands.name: Hard to Stern
commands.about: During combat on a ship, the player can put his ship and rigging at risk by putting the ship into an immediate hard turn to stern.

commands.name: High Jump
commands.about: Allows the character to leap into another room, where gravity will take it from there.

commands.name: Hire Crewmember
commands.about: From inside a pub or bar near the shore, the player can hire a local patron to man his or her ship.

commands.name: Identify Poison
commands.about: This skill allows the player to sniff and taste a potentially poisoned item (like a drink, or a sword) and tell what kind of poison (if any) is on the item.

commands.name: Improved Revoke
commands.about: Users of magic can revoke specific or multiple magical effects using the improved revoke command.

commands.name: Intercept Ship
commands.about: This powerful skill allows the sailor to use their superior sailing ability to quickly intercept a potential enemy ship of the given name.

commands.name: Jail Key
commands.about: Allows the player to lock or unlock any door to a jail room in the area.

commands.name: Lassoing
commands.about: If the player has a suitable rope, this will attempt to throw the rope at the target and, if hit, will bind the target for a short period.

commands.name: Leeching
commands.about: The player is able to apply leeches to the target.

commands.name: Lobotomizing
commands.about: The player is able to use delicate tools to scrape away unnecessary brain tissue from inside the target`s skull.

commands.name: Make Maps
commands.about: Allows you to begin mapping on the targeted piece of paper.

commands.name: Math
commands.about: Calculates the solution to a math problem.

commands.name: Meditation
commands.about: If the mage is in a quiet, sitting position, this skill will allow him or her to gain mana back at an accelerated rate.

commands.name: Mind Suck
commands.about: The character begins to suck the brain out of the target for nourishment.

commands.name: Morse Code
examples: morsecode I'm here at on my boat!
commands.about: This skill can be used to either tap on walls or flash a held light source in order to send morse code signals.

commands.name: Mounted Leap
commands.about: This skill allows either a mount, or a skilled rider of a mount to get the mount to leap through the air when entering the next room.

commands.name: Naval Tactics
commands.about: From the deck of a big sailing ship, and during ship combat, the sailor can automatically set a course on his or her ship according to a particular combat tactic.

commands.name: Nipple Twist
commands.about: The player grabs the targets nipples and gives them a twist, causing the target to take a bit of damage, and feel a horrible amount of pain.

commands.name: Planar Lore
commands.about: Through extensive education, the player is able to recall a random bit of information about one of the planes of existence.

commands.name: Planar Veil
commands.about: When in the wilderness on any plane except the prime material, the character maintains a state of being perfect hidden, regardless of actions taken.

commands.name: Prison Assignment
commands.about: This skill allows the player to convince the target officer to take a prisoner otherwise bound for an official jail cell to instead take the prisoner to a cell of the players prior designation.

commands.name: Prisoner Transfer
commands.about: This skill allows the player to convince a targeted law enforcement officer to take the next bound prisoner to the player`s location instead of to the intended judge.

commands.name: Racial Lore
commands.about: Through extensive education, the player is able to recall random bits of information about one of the many races.

commands.name: Recall
commands.about: The player calls upon the power of the gods to return to his or her place of origin, along with any npc group members present with him or her.

commands.name: Regional Awareness
commands.about: The player scans the horizon, getting a rough estimate of the lay of the wilderness around him or her.

commands.name: Research Item
commands.about: Inside a library or similar room full of books, the player attempts to research the location of some sought-after item.

commands.name: Research Region Map
commands.about: Inside a library or similar room full of books, the player attempts to research the location of some distant area, and find rare overland region maps showing the relative locations of the areas…

commands.name: Reveal Text
commands.about: The player reveals any invisible writing on a book or document or other writing.

commands.name: Revoke
commands.about: Mages, Clerics, and at later levels, Rangers and Paladins can revoke their magical abilities using the revoke command.

commands.name: Rope Dismount
commands.about: If the fighter has successfully managed to lasso a mounted target, this command will let them dig-in and dismount the target as well.

commands.name: Rope Tricks
commands.about: Using this skill, a player can use a held or wielded rope or lasso to perform amazing ticks, which might cause an observer to throw the player a coin.

commands.name: Memorize
commands.about: By spending the necessary practice points or trains, a Mage may use this command to gain the ability to learn some spell that is written on a scroll.

commands.name: Sea Charting
commands.about: This skill allows the player to keep track of various points of the sea on his or her nautical charts, from within a boat or sailing ship.

commands.name: Make Sea Maps
commands.about: Allows you to begin mapping the seas on the targeted piece of paper.

commands.name: Sea Navigation
commands.about: This skill works with the charts created with the Sea Charting skill to find the direction the player must steer their ship in order to reach a charted location.

commands.name: Secret Writing
examples: swrite parchment From recall, go nseeseenwesee
commands.about: Available: ALL This skill allows one to write invisible messages in common language onto ordinary paper, parchments, and similar writing material.

commands.name: Ship Lore
commands.about: Through extensive education, the player is able to recall random bits of information about a ship they can see.

commands.name: Shush
commands.about: The player is so intimidatingly adept at keeping others quiet, that he or she can give the universal SHUSH to a target and often make them agree to whisper and refrain from loud noises like spell…

commands.name: Slip
commands.about: This skill causes the target to slip and fall.

commands.name: Spread Apathy
commands.about: The character toggles whether they are in an aggressive state of apathy.

commands.name: Spread Hate
commands.about: The character toggles whether they are in an aggressive state of hatred.

commands.name: Stable Mount
commands.about: This skill allows the player, while either in a city, or a personal or clan home, to call for a stable boy to either take a mount away to a stable, or retrieve a mount from a local stable.

commands.name: Stowaway
commands.about: The sailor packs himself into a shipping crate bound for overseas travel, and, after a long sea voyage, emerges on a different shore.

commands.name: Subdue
commands.about: The fighter uses finesse to avoid killing the target by making more strategic hits on the target.

commands.name: Swim
commands.about: Available: ALL This skill allows the character to travel on a water surface.

commands.name: Tail Swipe
commands.about: The character uses their tail to make a powerful swipe at the legs of his or her enemies with their tail.

commands.name: Tie Down
commands.about: The sailor uses special knots to tie down a boat or large sailing ship at an official boat dock.

commands.name: Track Criminal
commands.about: The player attempts to find a trail leading from where he or she is at present, to the location of the indicated wanted criminal.

commands.name: Track Friend
commands.about: The player attempts to find a trail leading from where he or she is at present, to the location of the indicated friend, which is a group or clan member!

commands.name: Trade Charting
commands.about: This skill allows the player to keep track of various points of the roads on his or her trade charts from within a caravan.

commands.name: Trample
commands.about: A larger creature, from at least a small range, can charge and trample a smaller one, ending up at a similar range.

commands.name: Trip
commands.about: The fighter attempts to trip the target, putting them on the floor for a short time.

commands.name: Turn Undead
commands.about: The good or neutral priest attempts to frighten the heck out of an undead creature.

commands.name: Unearth Demography
commands.about: By finding scraps and tracks, the demographer can make some determination of the types of inhabitants within the local area.

commands.name: Whipsmack
commands.about: When using a leather flailed weapon in combat, this skill will deliver a punishing blunt smack across the target`s body, doing damage.

commands.name: Wilderness Lore
commands.about: Tells you what type of terrain you are presently in or on, and something about the climate.

commands.name: Write
examples: write parchment From recall, go nseeseenwesee
commands.about: Available: ALL This skill allows one to write ordinary messages onto ordinary paper, parchments, and similar writing material.

commands.name: a Dance
commands.about: Bards can invoke their magical dances using the dance command.

commands.name: a song played
commands.about: Bards can invoke their magical instruments using the play command.

commands.name: Ad Lib
commands.about: The bard begins watching the target carefully.

commands.name: Befriend
commands.about: This ability allows the bard to pick up new followers to join his or her adventures.

commands.name: Break A Leg
commands.about: The bard begins wishing everyone good luck (but especially his or her enemies), saying 'Break A Leg!'.

commands.name: Buffoonery
commands.about: This strange skill allows the player to swap out an existing worn or wielded item on the target with one of his or her own.

commands.name: Cast Blocking
commands.about: The bard carefully re-arranges all the people in the room who are in combat, possibly changing who they are fighting, and at what range.

commands.name: Center of Attention
commands.about: The bard begins performing loudly, flailing about dramatically.

commands.name: Conduct Symphony
commands.about: This powerful bard skill allows the bard to conduct their group as if it were a symphony.

commands.name: Curtain Call
commands.about: The bard calls the curtain, making everyone in his or her group begin taking a bow until their health and mana is restored, at the cost of movement.

commands.name: Disguise
commands.about: This powerful ability allows the bard to disguise his or her appearance in numerous ways.

commands.name: Exit Stage Left
commands.about: The bard calls the curtain and motions for his or her enemies to exit, stage left (West).

commands.name: False Arrest
commands.about: This skill allows the player to act as a bounty hunter or arresting officer for any area which enforces law.

commands.name: Fire Breathing
commands.about: If the player has a torch, or other burning object in his or her hands, they can use it to breathe fire at a target.

commands.name: Imitate
commands.about: This strange pseudo-magical skill allows spells, prayers, songs, and chants learned through Spellcraft, Prayercraft, etc to be faked at a later time.

commands.name: Instrument Bash
commands.about: The bard uses their instrument as a weapon, delivering an otherwise additional blow to the target in combat.

commands.name: Joke
commands.about: This will cause the player to tell a random joke to the target.

commands.name: Juggle
commands.about: This will cause the player to begin juggling one or more items.

commands.name: Light Placebo
commands.about: Through the power of prayer, the rougue can make the target feel like they've received a boost in health (which will vanish if they are damaged again)!

commands.name: Mark Disguise
commands.about: This powerful ability allows the bard to disguise him or herself to be identical to his or her mark.

commands.name: Mimicry
commands.about: The player begins to mimic the actions of the target, thus annoying them.

commands.name: Monologue
commands.about: The bard begins a dramatic monologue, causing everyone, friend and foe alike, to suspend all activity (including spell effects), until the bard is done.

commands.name: Placebo
commands.about: Through the power of prayer, the rougue can make the target feel like they've received a strong boost in health (which will vanish if they are damaged again)!

commands.name: Puppeteer
commands.about: This skill allows the player to animate one or more puppets.

commands.name: QuickChange
commands.about: The bard is so adept at costume changes that he can seemingly instantly remove all of his gear (putting it who knows where), retrieve another costume (from who knows where) and put it on.

commands.name: Satire
commands.about: This ability allows the bard to playfully mock and shame an officer of the law satirically, to his face.

commands.name: Shuffle
commands.about: This strange but very useful skill allows the player to rearrange the order of the people in the room by running around and bumping into them.

commands.name: Slapstick
commands.about: This will cause the player to perform some random slapstick comedy to or for the target.

commands.name: Song Write
commands.about: This skill allows the bard to place any song he or she knows onto a scroll.

commands.name: Strike The Set
commands.about: The bard strikes the set of the room, making any and all items in the room appear to be gone, and the room empty.

commands.name: Struggle
commands.about: The player wriggles and pulls to escape from bonds holding him or her.

commands.name: Tune Instrument
commands.about: The Bard tunes their instrument, which can provide bonuses to many songs which are played with it.

commands.name: Upstage
commands.about: The bard upstages his or her enemies, making them stop fighting who they were fighting, target the bard, and cross the room to reach him or her.

commands.name: Warrants
commands.about: The player, using nothing more than local contacts and charismatic persuasion, gathers information about all warrants and wanted criminals.

commands.name: Alertness
commands.about: The thief uses his or her acute vision to notice details about rooms he might otherwise miss.

commands.name: Ambush
commands.about: The thief directs the movements of his or her group members, positioning them so that they are in a hidden state, ready for an ambush.

commands.name: Appraise
commands.about: The thief carefully examines the item, determining (perhaps even successfully), the items material, weight, size (for armor), and base gold value.

commands.name: Arsonry
commands.about: If the thief is holding a torch or something else usable to spread fire, he may quickly light an available item, or a random item in an adjacent room using this skill.

commands.name: Articles
commands.about: This skill allows the player on their ship to offer the articles of piracy to the target bound or grouped npc.

commands.name: Assassinate
commands.about: The thief begins to track their mark for assassination.

commands.name: Astrology
commands.about: The gypsy studies the stars carefully to discern the future of the target.

commands.name: AutoDetect Traps
commands.about: The thief concentrates on scanning all exits and obvious items in a room for signs of traps whenever entering a room.

commands.name: AutoMark Traps
commands.about: The thief concentrates on scanning all exits and obvious items in a room for signs of traps whenever entering a room.

commands.name: AutoSwipe
commands.about: The player begins instinctively using their ability to swipe gold from people when moving through crowds.

commands.name: AutoCaltrops
commands.about: The thief quickly prepares a handful of caltrops and drops them into every room he or she enters automatically.

commands.name: AutoSneak
commands.about: The thief begins using his or her sneaking skill every time they move.

commands.name: Back Stab
commands.about: If the thief is hidden, or otherwise invisible to the target, this ability will allow him or her to deal a massive one-time attack to them.

commands.name: Belay
commands.about: This ability secures an item to the deck of a sailing ship, so that it cannot be washed overboard.

commands.name: Bind
commands.about: The thief uses ropes to bind the target, making them unable to move.

commands.name: Blend In
commands.about: Knowledge of the ways of other cities allows the character to blend in with local city populations, making the locals less likely to attack the rogue, if they were otherwise inclined to.

commands.name: Borrow Boon
commands.about: The thief will attempt to tap into the raw divine power of a holy item presently being held in order to borrow/copy a divine magical effect from the target and onto themselves.

commands.name: Bribe
commands.about: The thief will attempt to use money to get a target to do something for him or her.

commands.name: Call Urchins
commands.about: A thief calls on the urchins sworn to them in the current area to gather around the thief.

commands.name: Caltrops
commands.about: The thief drops numerous small metal spikes on the ground around him or her.

commands.name: Careful Step
commands.about: The thief moves slowly, watching every single footfall with utter care.

commands.name: Case Joint
commands.about: From the safety of a hidden position, the thief carefully examines a room noting the location of people and objects and their routines.

commands.name: Linguistic Comprehension
commands.about: This skill will cause the thief to begin listening intensely to what is being said around him in other languages, so that he or she may understand it.

commands.name: Con
commands.about: The thief will attempt to use trickery, and flattery to get a character to do something for him or her.

CHANT.name: Venomous Bite
CHANT.about: The druid's chant aids in the infliction of a poisonous bite on the target.

CHANT.name: Vine Mass
CHANT.about: If the druid is in a sufficiently foliated area, the druid may use their combat anger to animate numerous nearby vines to fight for the druid.

CHANT.name: Vine Weave
CHANT.about: If the druid is in a sufficiently vegetative area, this chant will cause a random woven item to grow out of the ground.

CHANT.name: Volcanic Chasm
CHANT.about: If the druid is in a cave room, this chant will turn it into a volcanic chasm, with sulfurous gasses and flames assaulting all who are within it.

CHANT.name: Waking Moon
CHANT.about: This chant will allow the moon to be seen during the day, so long as the druid is outside.

CHANT.name: Warning Winds
CHANT.about: This chant will allow the druid to be aware of enemies or fighting in nearby rooms.

CHANT.name: Warp Wood
CHANT.about: This chant will cause wooden weapons or items to begin to warp and mutate, taking considerable damage.

CHANT.name: Water Hammer
CHANT.about: If the druid has a sufficiently large source of water available, he or she can use this chant to gather the water into a tight compressed wave and hurl it at the target.

CHANT.name: Water Walking
CHANT.about: This chant will allow the druid to glide lightly above the water as if he or she is flying.

CHANT.name: Waterguard
CHANT.about: This chant will give the target a field of anti-water protection, lessening the damage from water based attacks for a brief time, and preventing any water damage to their equipment for the entire…

CHANT.name: Waterspout
CHANT.about: This chant will cause the surrounding waters to unleash a ferocious waterspout on all inhabitants.

CHANT.name: Whirlpool
CHANT.about: This chant, when cast out over the water, will sweep in any persons or ships out on the water into its grasp.

CHANT.name: Whisperward
CHANT.about: This is a complicated chant that allows an object or place to notify the druid when affected in a certain way.

CHANT.name: White Moon
CHANT.about: This chant will cause all chaotic creatures in the room to take double damage during combat, and all lawful in the room to take half damage.

CHANT.name: Wind Color
CHANT.about: This chant allows the druid, upon entering a new room, to gather information about the mobs and or items in the room.

CHANT.name: Wind Shape
CHANT.about: This chant causes the druid to shimmer and become like the wind.

CHANT.name: Wind Snatcher
CHANT.about: This chant creates a form around the druid which will suck in any wind-related magic that is used in the same room as the druid.

CHANT.name: Worms
CHANT.about: This chant will cause a horrid worm disease in the stomach of the target.

CHANT.name: Yearning
CHANT.about: This chant will cause the target to have a crazed need to mate.

PRAY.name: Absorption
PRAY.about: The cleric is able to absorb the knowledge of a random skill from the target.

PRAY.name: Acid Healing
PRAY.about: The caster places him or herself in a holy aura.

PRAY.name: Addicting Curse
PRAY.about: Curses the target food or drink, making it so that the next person who eats or drinks it becomes addicted to it.

PRAY.name: Adoption
PRAY.about: The cleric is able to bless the adoption of the child by the given parent.

PRAY.name: Airyform
PRAY.about: This prayer causes the caster to shimmer and become almost as air.

PRAY.name: Amplify Unholy Weapon
PRAY.about: This prayer will permanently amplify a weapon created with the unholy armament prayer.

PRAY.name: Anger
PRAY.about: In a room of peace, this prayer will cause all the inhabitants of a room to begin fighting another inhabitant, except the caster.

PRAY.name: Animal Spirit
PRAY.about: Causes the target to seek out their animal spirit and commune with it for a time.

PRAY.name: Animate Dead

PRAY.name: Animate Ghast
PRAY.about: Any dead body, of a mob or player level 7 or higher, may be animated with this prayer.

PRAY.name: Animate Ghost

PRAY.name: Animate Ghoul
PRAY.about: Any dead body, of a mob or player level 5 or higher, may be animated with this prayer.

PRAY.name: Animate Limb
PRAY.about: A properly amputated limb made of formerly living flesh is animated as a zombie-like limb creature.

PRAY.name: Animate Mummy
PRAY.about: Any dead body, of a mob or player level 20 or higher, may be animated with this prayer.

PRAY.name: Animate Shadow
PRAY.about: Any dead body, of a mob or player level 10 or higher, may be animated with this prayer.

PRAY.name: Animate Skeleton
PRAY.about: Any dead body, of a mob or player, may be animated with this prayer.

PRAY.name: Animate Spectre
PRAY.about: Any dead body, of a mob or player level 10 or higher, may be animated with this prayer.

PRAY.name: Animate Vampire
PRAY.about: Any dead body, of a mob or player level 25 or higher, may be animated with this prayer.

PRAY.name: Animate Zombie
PRAY.about: Any dead body, of a mob or player level 3 or higher, may be animated with this prayer.

PRAY.name: Annul
PRAY.about: This prayer breaks the marriage in which the target has entered.

PRAY.name: Anti Undead Field
PRAY.about: The caster becomes protected by an anti-undead field into which an aggressive undead creature may not advance.

PRAY.name: Atonement
PRAY.about: This prayer grants atonement to the target for his/her evil acts and slides them ever closer to the point of being truly good.

PRAY.name: Attune Relic
PRAY.about: This prayer expends one charge from a divine relic in an attempt to cause the relic to cast one of its prayers in a way that the caster might observe with their prayercraft skill.

PRAY.name: Attune Scroll
PRAY.about: This prayer expends some capacity from a divine scroll in an attempt to cause the scroll to cast one of its prayers in a way that the caster might observe with their prayercraft skill.

PRAY.name: Aura of Fear
PRAY.about: The Cleric can cause an aura of fear to surround any target.

PRAY.name: Aura of Harm
PRAY.about: Causes those in the same room as the cleric to suffer periodic damage, unless they are following the cleric.

PRAY.name: Aura of Healing
PRAY.about: Creates an aura of healing binding the area to the Cleric.

PRAY.name: Aura of Intolerance
PRAY.about: The Cleric becomes totally intolerant of nonbelief in his or her god, and especially of those who believe in other gods.

PRAY.name: Aura of Strife
PRAY.about: Creates an aura of strife around the cleric.

PRAY.name: Aura of the Divine Edict
PRAY.about: The Cleric gains the total authority of his or her god, being able to command all who are below him or her in level to obey by use of the YELL command.

PRAY.name: Avatar
PRAY.about: Causes the Cleric to become a most ferocious and powerful avatar of his or her god, gaining attack, armor, and hit point bonuses for the duration.

PRAY.name: Awaken
PRAY.about: The cleric is able to awaken everyone in the room, dispelling any sleep-causing effects at the same time.

PRAY.name: Behemoth
PRAY.about: This prayer causes the cleric to grow to a creature 3 times their normal size, with enhanced strength, but which is also somewhat easier to hit.

PRAY.name: Benediction
PRAY.about: This prayer causes the target to receive a bonus to their prime requisite stat(s) for their current class.

PRAY.name: Benigned Portal
PRAY.about: This prayer, which takes a long time to complete, causes a two-way portal to open to the world.

PRAY.name: Birds Eye
PRAY.about: With this prayer, the cleric becomes aware through divine revelation the places in his or her immediate area.

PRAY.name: Blade Barrier
PRAY.about: Causes a shield of blades to begin spinning around the caster.

PRAY.name: Bless
PRAY.about: The target of this spell becomes blessed by the caster's deity with an aura of Goodness, making them harder to hit in combat.

PRAY.name: Bless Item
PRAY.about: The item affected by this spell gains the blessing of the caster's deity with an aura of Goodness.

PRAY.name: Blessed Hearth
PRAY.about: The prayer consecrates the room in which it is cast against harm to owners of the room, or those who follow the owners.

PRAY.name: Blindness
PRAY.about: The mob affected by this spell is unable to see.

PRAY.name: Blindsight
PRAY.about: The mob affected by this spell is able to see in dark places, and has any blindness from a previous spell affect restored.

PRAY.name: Bloat Bomb
PRAY.about: This prayer instantly kills the target, if the target is sufficiently lower level than the caster.

PRAY.name: Blood Curse
PRAY.about: The caster causes an evil burning curse to be inflicted inside the target.

PRAY.name: Blood Hearth
PRAY.about: The prayer desecrates the room in which it is cast in favor of the owners of the room, or those who follow the owners.

PRAY.name: Bolster Poison
PRAY.about: Surrounds the target with a poison bolstering aura that causes any poison on the target to remain in full potency until this prayer expires.

PRAY.name: Bone Moon
PRAY.about: The caster causes an evil curse to rise over the room.

PRAY.name: Brightening Aura
PRAY.about: Surrounds the target with a brightening aura that enhances healing received from healing spells.

PRAY.name: Bury
PRAY.about: The caster burys a dead body in accordance with the will of his or her deity.

PRAY.name: Call Undead
PRAY.about: This prayer will cause one of the clerics absent undead group members to be drawn towards the clerics present location.

PRAY.name: Calm
PRAY.about: All fighting in the same room as the caster immediately ceases.

PRAY.name: Cause Critical Wounds
PRAY.about: Causes a critical blast of unholy damage to be inflicted on the target.

PRAY.name: Cause Exhaustion
PRAY.about: Creates fatigue, and removes a moderate amount of movement.

PRAY.name: Cause Fatigue
PRAY.about: Worsens fatigue, and removes a small amount of movement.

PRAY.name: Cause Light Wounds
PRAY.about: Causes a light blast of unholy damage to be inflicted on the target.

PRAY.name: Cause Serious Wounds
PRAY.about: Causes a serious blast of unholy damage to be inflicted on the target.

PRAY.name: Chain Strike
PRAY.about: This caster summons down a long arching stroke of lightning, which will hit a combatant of the caster (or a non-group member if not in combat), and begin bouncing from enemy to enemy until the…

PRAY.name: Change Weather
PRAY.about: This prayer asks the casters god to change the weather outside.

PRAY.name: Christen
PRAY.about: This prayer is the only means of giving a mud born child a name, and thereby ensuring that it will grow up to be a player.

PRAY.name: Cleanliness
PRAY.about: Brings the target closer to divinity by removing dirt, grime, and stink from the target mob, baby, item, or room.

PRAY.name: Condemnation
PRAY.about: This unholy spell is applicable only against targets who are already wanted in the casting area for a crime.

PRAY.name: Consecrate Land
PRAY.about: This prayer consecrates the land on which it is cast, making evil prayers unable to function here.

PRAY.name: Contagion
PRAY.about: This wicked spell makes all other wicked spells contagious.

PRAY.name: Conviction
PRAY.about: This prayer fills the target with religious conviction.

PRAY.name: Corpse Walk
PRAY.about: This spell teleports the cleric and his or her followers to the corpse given by the name of this spell.

PRAY.name: Corruption
PRAY.about: This prayer corrupts the target and slides them ever closer to the point of being truly evil.

PRAY.name: Create Food
PRAY.about: Causes a bit of food to fall near to the caster from out of nowhere.

PRAY.name: Create Idol
PRAY.about: This prayer creates an idol to the clerics god out of natural resources grown out of the ground around the caster.

PRAY.name: Create Water
PRAY.about: Causes the targeted container to fill up with fresh water.

PRAY.name: Cure Blindness

PRAY.about: Cures the curse of cannibalism from the target.

PRAY.name: Cure Critical Wounds
PRAY.about: Delivers critical healing to the target.

PRAY.name: Cure Deafness
PRAY.about: Delivers the target from any deafening spells or affects.

PRAY.name: Cure Disease
PRAY.about: Cures all manner of disease and disease like affects.

PRAY.about: Eliminates fatigue, and restores a moderate amount of movement.

PRAY.name: Cure Fatigue
PRAY.about: Delivers invigoration to the fatigued, and restores a small amount of movement.

PRAY.name: Cure Light Wounds
PRAY.about: Delivers light healing to the target.

PRAY.name: Cure Serious Wounds
PRAY.about: Delivers serious healing to the target.

PRAY.name: Cure Vampirism
PRAY.about: Cures the curse of vampirism from the target.

PRAY.about: The target of this spell becomes cursed by the caster's deity with an aura of Evil, making them easier to hit in combat.

PRAY.name: Curse Flames
PRAY.about: The target of this spell becomes the target of a flaming or burning object either in the room, or in possession of the target.

PRAY.name: Curse Item
PRAY.about: The item affected by this spell gains the curses of the caster's deity.

PRAY.name: Curse Luck
PRAY.about: This wicked spell makes the target to fail their next three saving throws against any magic, trap, disease, poison, or similar affect.

PRAY.name: Curse Metal
PRAY.about: Any and all metal objects being held or worn by the target are filled with unholy heat.

PRAY.name: Curse Mind
PRAY.about: The mind of the target of this spell is cursed, making them more susceptible to mind-influencing attacks.

PRAY.name: Curse Minds
PRAY.about: The mind of all the targets of this spell are cursed, making them more susceptible to mind-influencing attacks.

PRAY.name: Daily Bread
PRAY.about: The target of this prayer becomes compelled to turn over any food they might have to the cleric.

PRAY.name: Dark Senses
PRAY.about: Makes the target capable of seeing in the dark.

PRAY.name: Darkening Aura
PRAY.about: Surrounds the target with a darkening aura that enhances damage received from unholy magic.

PRAY.name: Deafness
PRAY.about: Makes the target completely deaf.

PRAY.name: Death Guard
PRAY.about: The target of this prayer comes under the guardianship of the cleric and his or her God.

PRAY.about: The target of this prayer comes under a curse that will cause them to instantly die should they fall below 10% health.

PRAY.name: Deaths Door
PRAY.about: The caster becomes protected from death.

PRAY.about: This prayer allows malicious unholy magic to be permanently melded with an empowered shield that has no extraneous existing effects on it.

PRAY.about: When holding a perfectly mundane shield, the player can briefly summon their intense faith in their deity to believe that hostile divine magic will not touch them.

PRAY.name: Demonic Consumption
PRAY.about: The caster attempts to cause the target item or mob to be consumed by unholy forces.

PRAY.name: Demonshield
PRAY.about: The caster causes a shield of demonic flames to erupt around the target, protecting them from the attacks of non-evil creatures.

PRAY.name: Deplete Relic
PRAY.about: This prayer depletes the charges on any target divine relic.

PRAY.name: Deplete Scroll
PRAY.about: This prayer removes the markings on any target object containing writing.

PRAY.name: Desecrate
PRAY.about: The caster desecrates a dead body before his or her deity.

PRAY.name: Desecrate Land
PRAY.about: This prayer desecrates the land on which it is cast, making good prayers unable to function here.

PRAY.name: Designation
PRAY.about: This prayer allows the cleric to give a new designation/name to one of his/her undead.

PRAY.name: Devourer Curse
PRAY.about: The caster causes the target to have the face of a devourer demon, reducing their charisma to almost nothing as they become a target of loathing and hatred.

PRAY.name: Discipline
PRAY.about: This prayer builds discipline into the target's mind and slides them ever closer to the point of being more lawful.

PRAY.name: Disown
PRAY.about: The target baby or toddler mob in the clerics group loses any christening they might have, along with parentage, and the protection of childhood.

PRAY.name: Dispel Chaos
PRAY.about: The target becomes exorcised of their will.

PRAY.name: Dispel Evil
PRAY.about: The target becomes exorcised of their evil.

PRAY.name: Dispel Good
PRAY.about: The target becomes exorcised of their goodness.

PRAY.name: Dispel Law
PRAY.about: The target becomes exorcised of their discipline.

PRAY.name: Dispel Undead
PRAY.about: The target becomes exorcised of their undeadness.

PRAY.name: Divine Constitution
PRAY.about: The target becomes covered in divine constitution.

PRAY.name: Divine Guidance

PRAY.name: Divine Luck
PRAY.about: The caster gains the luck of the gods, hitting more easily, doing more damage in combat, and having better saving throws.

PRAY.name: Divine Perspective
PRAY.about: This prayer allows the cleric, for a short time, to see the universe through the eyes of his or her deity.

PRAY.name: Divine Resistance
PRAY.about: The target becomes protected by divine resistance, which completely blocks three harmful affects that would require a saving throw, such as spells, traps, diseases, poisons, etc.

PRAY.name: Divorce
PRAY.about: This prayer breaks the marriage in which the target has entered.

PRAY.name: Doom Aura
PRAY.about: Causes an aura of dread and doom to surround the caster.

PRAY.name: Doomspout
PRAY.about: Inflicts the target with a horrendous mental disease that sucks away the targets intellect, and forces them to spout messages of doom.

PRAY.name: Drain
PRAY.about: Causes some of the life force of the target to be transferred to the cleric.

PRAY.name: Dream Feast
PRAY.about: This spell puts a blessing from the casters god upon the target.

PRAY.name: Drunken Stupor
PRAY.about: This prayer causes the target to become inebriated.

PRAY.name: Earth to Mud
PRAY.about: The caster turns the rock or sandy ground into mushy mud.

PRAY.name: Earthshield
PRAY.about: This prayer will cause the cleric to be surrounded by an earthy shield.

PRAY.name: Electric Healing
PRAY.about: The caster places him or herself in a holy aura.

PRAY.name: Electric Strike
PRAY.about: Causes the caster's hands to deal out a strong spray of electricity upon the target, which will probably hurt them.

PRAY.name: Elemental Aid
PRAY.about: This powerful prayer will cause a powerful elemental, equal in strength to near the Clerics level, to appear and follow the cleric.

PRAY.name: Elemental Portal
PRAY.about: This prayer, which takes a long time to complete, causes a two-way portal to open to the world.

PRAY.name: Ember
PRAY.about: The caster causes a small flaming ember to appear and attack the target.

PRAY.name: Empower Sacred Weapon
PRAY.about: This prayer causes a weapon to become permanently empowered and magical.

PRAY.name: Empower Unholy Armor

PRAY.name: Empower Unholy Weapon
PRAY.about: This prayer causes a weapon to become permanently empowered and magical.

PRAY.about: This prayer allows the cleric to place any prayer he or she knows onto an empty relic.

PRAY.name: Enervate
PRAY.about: Creates fatigue, and removes the largest amount of movement.

PRAY.name: Eternal Item
PRAY.about: This overwhelmingly powerful prayer makes the item impervious to damage or destruction, forever.

PRAY.name: Etherealness
PRAY.about: The caster places him or herself in an ethereal state.

PRAY.name: Extinguish
PRAY.about: This powerful prayer will extinguish any torches, or fire-based spells on the target.

PRAY.name: Faithful HellHound
PRAY.about: In the heat of combat, the caster can call forth a mighty fire breathing hellhound from the depths to be his or her faithful companion for a period of time.

PRAY.name: Faithless
PRAY.about: The caster compells the target to rebuke their god.

PRAY.name: Feed The Dead

PRAY.about: This prayer transfers the given amount of experience from the caster to the target undead creature.

PRAY.name: Feign Life
PRAY.about: The caster causes the target to appear as a living human, instead of whatever they might be presently.

PRAY.name: Fertilize
PRAY.about: The caster blesses the land, making yields from Foraging, Shrooming, and Farming double for a whole day per level of the caster.

PRAY.name: Fidelity
PRAY.about: This prayer makes the target unable to mate with anyone but their husband or bride, if they are married.

PRAY.name: Find Sacred Item
PRAY.about: The caster goes into communion with his or her deity, allowing him or her to locate a particular item that has been bound to the deity, as per the Empower Weapon/Armor prayers.

PRAY.name: Fire Healing
PRAY.about: The caster places him or herself in a holy aura.

PRAY.name: Flame Weapon
PRAY.about: The caster causes flames to consume the weapon, making the weapon more dangerous in combat, and causing it to hit more often.

PRAY.name: Flesh Rock
PRAY.about: The caster turns the target into a statue of jagged rock.

PRAY.name: Fluency
PRAY.about: This prayer allows the caster to speak, but not understand, any unknown language that the intelligent target of their speech is presently speaking.

PRAY.name: Forgive
PRAY.about: The cleric asks the deities to create feelings of forgiveness from the law towards a criminal who has a warrant out for their arrest.

PRAY.name: Fortress

PRAY.name: Fountain of Life
PRAY.about: The caster causes a beautiful fountain to begin flowing.

PRAY.name: Freedom
PRAY.about: Any binding and entangling spells or affects on the target are immediately dispelled.

PRAY.about: This spell causes the metal objects being worn or wielded by the target to begin freezing and biting at their skin, and freeze to whatever they are touching.

PRAY.name: Gateway

PRAY.name: Gills
PRAY.about: The gods bestow upon the caster water breathing gills, with which he or she may breathe comfortably under water.

PRAY.name: Hellfire

PRAY.name: Heresy
PRAY.about: This wicked prayer will accuse the target of heresy against his or her god.

PRAY.name: Hold Undead
PRAY.about: The caster invokes a very temporary divine hold upon undead enemies, preventing them from moving for a short time.

PRAY.about: The target of this spell is embraced by the caster's deity in a holy aura, making them harder to hit in combat, and giving aid against enemies in combat.

PRAY.about: Causes the caster's deity to blast enemies with a great gust of holy wind, blowing them back, and perhaps even down.
