PRAY.about: This prayer allows benevolent divine magic to be permanently melded with a divinely empowered shield that has no other extraneous existing effects on it.

PRAY.name: Imbue Unholy Weapon
PRAY.about: This prayer allows divine magic to be permanently melded with a previously empowered weapon that has no other extraneous existing effects on it.

PRAY.name: Improved Warding Glyph
PRAY.about: Allows the caster to cast a prayer when the next person opens, or unlocks a particular door.

PRAY.name: Incite Dead
PRAY.about: This prayer causes all non-enemy undead in the room to be incited to attack anyone not under the clerics protection.

PRAY.name: Inflict Cannibalism
PRAY.about: This horrid curse causes the target to develop an insatiable hunger for the flesh of their own race.

PRAY.name: Inflict Vampirism
PRAY.about: This horrid curse causes the target to develop an insatiable hunger for blood.

PRAY.name: Infuse Balance
PRAY.about: The target becomes covered by a blanket of balance, which overcomes any other magic which may be creating auras of good or evil.

PRAY.name: Infuse Discipline
PRAY.about: The target becomes covered by a blanket of discipline, making it appear lawful to prayers or other means of detecting such.

PRAY.name: Infuse Holiness
PRAY.about: The target becomes covered by a blanket of holiness, making it appear good to prayers or other means of detecting such.

PRAY.name: Infuse Impunity
PRAY.about: The target becomes covered by a blanket of willful impunity, making it appear chaotic to prayers or other means of detecting such.

PRAY.name: Infuse Moderation
PRAY.about: The target becomes covered by a blanket of moderation, making it appear balanced between law and chaos to prayers or other means of detecting such.

PRAY.name: Infuse Unholiness
PRAY.about: The target becomes covered by a blanket of unholiness, making it appear evil to prayers or other means of detecting such.

PRAY.name: Invigorate
PRAY.about: Eliminates fatigue, and restores the largest amount of movement.

PRAY.name: Invisibility to Undead
PRAY.about: This prayer makes the caster invisible to undead creatures, making the caster harder to hit for undead creatures, and making it easier to avoid aggressive undead.

PRAY.name: Joyous Rapture
PRAY.about: The caster prays that the target be filled with joy, or at least less hate.

PRAY.name: Judgement
PRAY.about: The caster prays that the target be put under a geas which they must fulfill before the spell expires, or die.

PRAY.name: Lesser Warding Glyph
PRAY.about: Allows the caster to cast a prayer when the next person opens, unlocks, or gets something from a container.

PRAY.name: Linked Health
PRAY.about: The caster and the target become linked in their combat damage.

PRAY.name: Lower Law
PRAY.about: This prayer divinely reveals the moral, non-divine, "lower" law active in the area occupied by the caster.

PRAY.name: Major Infusion
PRAY.about: Restores the largest amount of mana to the target.

PRAY.name: Malediction
PRAY.about: This prayer causes the target to receive half experience gains, and double experience losses for the duration of the prayer.

PRAY.name: Maligned Portal
PRAY.about: This prayer, which takes a long time to complete, causes a two-way portal to open to the world.

PRAY.name: Marry
PRAY.about: This prayer requires two targets, which must be in the same room as the cleric.

PRAY.name: Mass Blindness
PRAY.about: Causes blindness to afflict everyone in the same room as the caster, except the caster and his or her group.

PRAY.name: Mass Cure Disease
PRAY.about: This powerful prayer will cure all disease in an entire area.

PRAY.name: Mass Deafness
PRAY.about: Causes deafness to descend on everyone in the same room as the caster, except the caster and his or her group.

PRAY.name: Mass Forgive
PRAY.about: The cleric asks the deities to create feelings of forgiveness from the law towards all criminals who have warrants out for their arrest.

PRAY.name: Mass Freedom
PRAY.about: All binding and entangling spells or affects on anyone in the room are immediately dispelled.

PRAY.name: Mass Grave
PRAY.about: If cast at a location where unworked stone or soil is below the caster`s feet, this prayer will cause the caster and his or her group to be buried underground.

PRAY.name: Mass Harm
PRAY.about: Causes a DEVASTATING blast of unholy damage to be inflicted on everyone in the same room as the caster, except the caster and his or her group.

PRAY.name: Mass Heal
PRAY.about: Delivers MASSIVE healing to everyone in the same room or group as the caster.

PRAY.name: Mass Mobility
PRAY.about: Everyone in the same room as the caster and the casters group obtain divine protection from immobilizing spells and affects, such as Hold or Paralyze, etc.

PRAY.name: Mass Paralyze
PRAY.about: Causes a paralyzing grip to descend on everyone in the same room as the caster, except the caster and his or her group.

PRAY.name: Mass Tongues
PRAY.about: Causes everyone nearby, except the caster and his or her group, to become cursed by the caster's deity, forcing them to speak a random language they may not understand when heard.

PRAY.name: Mercy
PRAY.about: The cleric instills a blessing of mercy upon the room, preventing spells or swords from doing damage.

PRAY.name: Minor Infusion
PRAY.about: Restores a small amount of mana to the target.

PRAY.name: Moderate Infusion
PRAY.about: Restores a moderate amount of mana to the target.

PRAY.name: Monolith
PRAY.about: Causes an enormous monolith to be erected between the caster and his or her enemies.

PRAY.name: Moral Balance
PRAY.about: This prayer shows evil beings a little bit of the good in the world, and shows good beings some of the evil and corruption.

PRAY.name: Morph Unholy Weapon
PRAY.about: This prayer will permanently morph a weapon created with the unholy armament prayer.

PRAY.name: Neutralize Item
PRAY.about: Dispels all enchantments, and many special properties and qualities from an item, armor, or weapon.

PRAY.name: Neutralize Land
PRAY.about: This prayer neutralizes the land on which it is cast, removing any spells, prayers, songs, or chants that might have been enchanted upon it.

PRAY.name: Nourishing Food
PRAY.about: This prayer will make any normally edible meal into an extremely nourishing and filling one.

PRAY.name: Nullification
PRAY.about: Causes all spells cast on everyone in the same room to be conditionally dispelled, depending on the level of the caster.

PRAY.name: Omnipresence
PRAY.about: This prayer causes the presence of the caster to be divinely expanded to numerous nearby locations.

PRAY.name: Pacify
PRAY.about: This prayer fills the target with passive non-aggressive feelings.

PRAY.name: Paralyze
PRAY.about: Causes a paralyzing grip to descend on the target.

PRAY.name: Peace Ritual
PRAY.about: This prayer may only be cast by a cleric who belongs to a clan.

PRAY.name: Philosophy
PRAY.about: The priest prays for some target and encourages him or her to ponder the mysteries of the universe.

PRAY.name: Piety Curse
PRAY.about: This prayer puts the target under a piety curse.

PRAY.name: Plague
PRAY.about: Inflicts the target with a horrendous disease.

PRAY.name: Planar Plague
PRAY.about: Inflicts the target with a horrendous glowing extra-planar disease if the target is not presently on their native plane of existence.

PRAY.name: Planar Travel
PRAY.about: This prayer allows the cleric and his/her group to shift into another plane of existence for a period of time.

PRAY.name: Position
PRAY.about: With this prayer, the cleric becomes aware through divine revelation the trail from the place he or she was the last time they cast the prayer to where they are now.

PRAY.name: Preserve Body
examples: pray "preserve body" body of an orc
PRAY.about: This prayer causes a target body not to decay over time.

PRAY.name: Preserve Knowledge
PRAY.about: This prayer preserves the casters knowledge by preventing half of all experience lost, up to a limit.

PRAY.name: Prophecy
PRAY.about: The caster goes into a deep divine trance for several moments.

PRAY.name: Protect Health
PRAY.about: The caster gains divine immunity from poison, plague, and certain mind attacks, such as the charm spell, and some bard songs.

PRAY.name: Protect Item
PRAY.about: This prayer grants the target item temporary divine protection from destruction or wear and tear.

PRAY.name: Protect Sacred Item
PRAY.about: This prayer grants the target sacred item divine protection from destruction or wear and tear forever.

PRAY.name: Protected Mount
PRAY.about: This prayer asks the gods to give a favored or racial animal mount the wisdom to flee before being killed.

PRAY.name: Protection Bless
PRAY.about: The caster gains divine immunity from holy blessings.

PRAY.name: Protection Chaos
PRAY.about: The caster gains divine immunity from chaotic spells, and a greater level of defence when fighting chaotic creatures.

PRAY.name: Protection Cold
PRAY.about: The caster gains a level of protection from cold based attacks.

PRAY.name: Protection Curses
PRAY.about: The caster gains a level of protection from curse magical attacks.

PRAY.name: Protection Death
PRAY.about: The target gains a measure of protection from death.

PRAY.name: Protection Disease
PRAY.about: The caster gains divine immunity from diseases and disease attacks.

PRAY.name: Protection Elements
PRAY.about: The caster gains divine immunity from certain elemental attacks, including fire, water, cold, and gas.

PRAY.name: Protection Evil
PRAY.about: The caster gains divine immunity from unholy spells, and a greater level of defence when fighting evil creatures.

PRAY.name: Protection Fire
PRAY.about: The caster gains a level of protection from fire based attacks.

PRAY.name: Protection Good
PRAY.about: The caster gains divine immunity from holy spells, and a greater level of defence when fighting good creatures.

PRAY.name: Protection Law
PRAY.about: The caster gains divine immunity from lawful spells, and a greater level of defence when fighting lawful creatures.

PRAY.name: Protection Outsiders
PRAY.about: The caster gains a small bit of divine protection from outsider creatures (demons, elementals, etc) when fighting them.

PRAY.name: Protection Paralyzation
PRAY.about: The caster gains divine immunity from paralyzing spells and affects.

PRAY.name: Protection Poison
PRAY.about: The caster gains divine immunity from poisoning creatures and affects.

PRAY.name: Protection Undead
PRAY.about: The caster gains a much higher defence against the undead in normal combat.

PRAY.name: Purify
PRAY.about: The target must be a food or drink source.

PRAY.name: Read Language
PRAY.about: This prayer allows the prayer to understand written materials written in any other language.

PRAY.name: Read Prayer
PRAY.about: This prayer is required in order to be able to invoke prayers off of divine scrolls.

PRAY.name: Recharge Relic
PRAY.about: This prayer allows the caster to recharge the magical properties of a divine relic.

PRAY.name: Reflect Prayer
PRAY.about: When holding a perfectly mundane shield, the player can briefly summon their intense faith in their deity to believe that hostile divine magic will be reflected back at the caster.

PRAY.name: Refresh
PRAY.about: Restores all mana, hit points, and movement.

PRAY.name: Refuge
PRAY.about: This long lasting magic binds the target item to the room in which this spell was cast.

PRAY.name: Regeneration
PRAY.about: The caster recovers hit points, mana, and movement at FOUR times the normal rate, for the duration of the prayer.

PRAY.name: Regrowth
PRAY.about: This prayer regrows any amputated limbs on the target.

PRAY.name: Release Prayer
PRAY.about: This prayer allows the caster to release one or more temporary divine prayers they know without needing to properly cast them.

PRAY.name: Religious Doubt
PRAY.about: Causes the target to begin doubting their religious faith, which makes them immune to religious conversion for a time, but unable to receive the blessings of their deity also.

PRAY.name: Remove Curse
PRAY.about: Removes any cursed items or curses on the target.

PRAY.name: Remove Death Mark
PRAY.about: Removes any thief/assassin marks, as well as making those involved in a burglars contract hit forget their job.

PRAY.name: Remove Inhibitions
PRAY.about: This prayer removes inhibitions from the target's mind and slides them ever closer to the chaos.

PRAY.name: Remove Paralysis
PRAY.about: Removes any unholy paralysis from the target.

PRAY.name: Remove Poison
PRAY.about: Removes any poison coursing through the veins of the target.

PRAY.name: Restoration
PRAY.about: At the cost of all mana, this prayer restores all hit points, cures any ailments, and restores any destroyed limbs.

PRAY.name: Restore Smell
PRAY.about: Since one can hardly imagine a player being able to proceed in CoffeeMud without a sense of smell, the Cleric is hereby granted the supreme privilege of restoring this absolutely vital sense.

PRAY.name: Restore Voice
PRAY.about: This prayer will dispel any affects on the target which may be muting him or her.

PRAY.name: Resurrect
PRAY.about: By targeting the cold dead body of a compatriot, the caster can resurrect them.

PRAY.name: Resurrect Mount
PRAY.about: By targeting the cold dead body of a creature you've been riding, the caster can resurrect them.

PRAY.name: Retribution
PRAY.about: Causes the caster to be filled with the power of retribution.

PRAY.name: Revival
PRAY.about: The cleric begins a revival, shouting the praises of his or her god.

PRAY.name: Righteous Indignation
PRAY.about: This prayer causes the target to receive a small boost of experience when killing evil.

PRAY.name: Rock Flesh
PRAY.about: This magic dispels the effect of either the Flesh to Rock prayer, or the Flesh to Stone arcane spell.

PRAY.name: Rockskin
PRAY.about: The caster turns their skin into hard rock, which will then absorb a limited number of weapon attacks, saving the caster from the damage

PRAY.name: Rot
PRAY.about: The target must be a food or drink source.

PRAY.name: Sacred Imbuing Quest
examples: pray "sacred imbuing quest" sanctuary shield bob
PRAY.about: This prayer will grant a player a quest which will allows a prayer to be permanently melded with a mundane item that has no existing effects on it.

PRAY.name: Sacrifice
PRAY.about: The caster sacrifices a dead body to his or her deity.

PRAY.name: Sanctify Room
PRAY.about: This prayer, typically used by the clergy on their own churches, prevents any items in the room from being removed without the presence of the caster or the owner.

PRAY.name: Sanctimonious
PRAY.about: The caster prays to become sanctimonious, which gives him or her extra defense, attack, and damaging ability against those who are good, but less good than the caster.

PRAY.name: Sanctuary
PRAY.about: The caster causes a protective field to surround the target.

PRAY.name: Sanctum
PRAY.about: The caster makes the room a sanctum.

PRAY.name: Seekers Prayer
PRAY.about: The caster communes with his or her deity to hear the prayers of seekers and quest-givers around the world, gaining knowledge of their identity and location.

PRAY.name: Sense Alignment
PRAY.about: The caster gains the ability to look into the soul of the target and see their alignment.

PRAY.name: Sense Allergies
PRAY.about: The caster gains the ability to look into the body of the target and see their allergies.

PRAY.name: Sense Bombs
PRAY.about: The caster gains the ability to sense evil bombs among items, in containers, or being carried by people as the cleric walks around.

PRAY.name: Sense Chants
PRAY.about: The caster gains the ability to look into the target and see their known chants.

PRAY.name: Sense Chaos
PRAY.about: The caster gains the ability to sense chaotic creatures and items.

PRAY.name: Sense Devotion
PRAY.about: The caster's deity reveals the faith of the target, allowing he or she to know who the target worships.

PRAY.name: Sense Disease
PRAY.about: The caster's deity reveals the presence of disease in the immediate surrounding area.

PRAY.name: Sense Evil
PRAY.about: The caster gains the ability to sense evil creatures and items.

PRAY.name: Sense Faithful
PRAY.about: The caster instantly knows everyone in the world who also worships the same deity as the caster.

PRAY.name: Sense Good
PRAY.about: The caster gains the ability to sense good creatures and items.

PRAY.name: Sense Hidden
PRAY.about: The caster gains divine sight, being able to see any hidden creatures or items.

PRAY.name: Sense Injury
PRAY.about: The caster gains the ability to sense presence of injuries in any beings in the immediate surrounding area.

PRAY.name: Sense Invisible
PRAY.about: The caster gains divine sight, being able to see any invisible creatures or items.

PRAY.name: Sense Law
PRAY.about: The caster gains the ability to sense lawful creatures and items.

PRAY.name: Sense Life
PRAY.about: The caster's deity reveals the presence of life in the immediate surrounding area.

PRAY.name: Sense Magic
PRAY.about: The caster gains divine sight, being able to see which creatures or items have a magical aura.

PRAY.name: Sense Parish
PRAY.about: The caster gains knowledge about the location of followers of a particular deity in their immediate area.

PRAY.name: Sense Prayers
PRAY.about: The caster gains the ability to look into the target and see their known prayers.

PRAY.name: Sense Professions
PRAY.about: The caster gains the ability to look into the target and see their known common skills.

PRAY.name: Sense Resistances
PRAY.about: The caster gains the ability to look into the aura of the target and see any special resistances to natural, elemental, magical, or other effects.

PRAY.name: Sense Skills
PRAY.about: The caster gains the ability to look into the target and see their known skills.

PRAY.name: Sense Songs
PRAY.about: The caster gains the ability to look into the target and see their known songs.

PRAY.name: Sense Spells
PRAY.about: The caster gains the ability to look into the target and see their known spells.

PRAY.name: Sense Traps
PRAY.about: The caster gains the ability to sense evil traps in doors, items, or on people as the cleric walks around.

PRAY.name: Sense Undead
PRAY.about: The caster gains sensitivity to dark souls, being able to know instantly who in the same room as them is undead.

PRAY.name: Sermon
PRAY.about: The cleric delivers a divinely inspired sermon of such power that all who hear it may become feverish followers of the cleric`s deity.

PRAY.name: Share Boon
PRAY.about: This prayer extends the effect of some benevolent prayer on the caster to his or her entire group.

PRAY.name: Silent
PRAY.about: The caster inflicts the inability to speak upon the target, inhibiting wand usage, verbal spellcasting, and other important speaking abilities.

PRAY.name: Snake Staff
PRAY.about: If the cleric is wielding a staff-type weapon, or one favored by his/her deity, this prayer will cause the weapon to turn briefly into a group of snakes which will defend the caster in battle.

PRAY.name: Sober
PRAY.about: Removes any alcohol coursing through the veins of the target.

PRAY.name: Soul Peering
PRAY.about: This prayer divinely reveals complete statistics about the target to the caster.

PRAY.name: Speak with Dead
PRAY.about: The caster kneels down and whispers with the corpse, discovering its identity, and some details of his or her passing.

PRAY.name: Stasis
PRAY.about: The caster places the target in a holy stasis field.

PRAY.name: Stoning
PRAY.about: The caster calls for a stoning of the target.

PRAY.name: Sun Curse
PRAY.about: The caster places the target under a horrible sun curse.

PRAY.name: Taint of Chaos
PRAY.about: This prayer causes the target to have the taint of a chaotic curse.

PRAY.name: Taint of Evil
PRAY.about: This prayer causes the target to have the taint of evil curse.

PRAY.name: Thunderbolt
PRAY.about: The caster summons a mighty force of his or her god and delivers it full-on at the target in one damaging strike.

PRAY.name: Tithe
PRAY.about: The caster compells the target to give 10% of all their takings in tithe to the cleric.

PRAY.name: Tongues
PRAY.about: The target of this spell becomes cursed by the caster's deity, forcing them to speak a random language they may not understand when heard.

PRAY.name: Transfer Bane
PRAY.about: The caster attempts to transfer a malicious divine curse they are suffering from to the target.

PRAY.name: Transfer Boon
PRAY.about: The caster attempts to transfer a beneficial divine prayer they are affected by to the target.

PRAY.name: Tremor
PRAY.about: This powerful prayer will cause the earth beneath the druids enemies to begin shaking violently.

PRAY.name: True Resurrection
PRAY.about: The caster summons the soul of the departed from the spirit realm and returns it to their corpse, causing them to become resurrected.

PRAY.name: Undeath Guard
PRAY.about: The undead target of this prayer comes under the guardianship of the cleric and his or her God.

PRAY.name: Undeniable Faith
PRAY.about: The target of this prayer immediately professes belief in the clerics god, and remains a believer for a mud month.

PRAY.name: Unholy Armament
PRAY.about: This prayer causes a needed armor piece or weapon to appear in the same room as the cleric.

PRAY.name: Unholy Poison
PRAY.about: The cleric prays that his or her god inflict a horrible poison into the blood of the target.

PRAY.name: Unholy Portent
PRAY.about: This prayer curses the target against defying evil.

PRAY.name: Unholy Word
PRAY.about: Everyone hearing the unholy word is affected by this spell.

PRAY.name: Water To Wine
PRAY.about: This prayer asks the casters god to change fresh water into wine.

PRAY.name: Wave
PRAY.about: This prayer causes all non-group members to be swept away by a massive crashing wave.

PRAY.name: Wings
PRAY.about: This prayer causes the caster to gain a pair of broad wings with which he can fly into the heavens (or anywhere else flying-to is required).

PRAY.name: Word of Chaos
PRAY.about: Everyone hearing the word of chaos is affected by this spell.

PRAY.name: Word of Law
PRAY.about: Everyone hearing the word of law is affected by this spell.

DANCE.name: Ballet
DANCE.about: This highly graceful dance form grants the dancer and his or her party a great bonus to Dexterity.

DANCE.name: Basse
DANCE.about: This highly dignified walking dance from France will make the dancer and his or her party unattackable by aggressive monsters, due to the monsters awe of the dancers.

DANCE.name: Butoh
DANCE.about: This expressionist dance form, highly spiritual in nature, assist the dancer and his or her party in the recovery of mana.

DANCE.name: Butterfly
DANCE.about: This Native American dance grants the dancer and his or her party the ability to fly.

DANCE.name: Can-Can
DANCE.about: This exihilirating, high-kicking dance allows the dancer and his or her party to get an extra kick attack every combat round.

DANCE.name: Capoeira
DANCE.about: This acrobatic and athletic Brazilian fighting dance grants the dancer and his or her party bonus attack and damage when fighting unarmed.

DANCE.name: Clog Dance
DANCE.about: This loud, thumping folk dance will make the dancer's enemies clumsy in combat.

DANCE.name: Cotillon
DANCE.about: This ballroom dance, characterized by couples switching partners, will cause the dancer and his or her party to automatically rescue each other during combat.

DANCE.name: Courante
DANCE.about: This French running dance grants the dancer and his or her party an extra attack per round.

DANCE.name: Flamenco
DANCE.about: This Spanish dance, charicterized by stamping footwork, will cause damage to the dancer's enemies.

DANCE.name: Foxtrot
DANCE.about: This slow marching dance allows the dancer and his or her party to recover mana and movement at an accelerated rate.

DANCE.name: Grass
DANCE.about: This religious dance of Native Americans grants the dancer and his or her party the same affect as the BLESS prayer, which is a bonus to armor.

DANCE.name: Jingledress
DANCE.about: This Native American religious dance grants a healing affect to the dancer and his or her party every tick.

DANCE.name: Jitterbug
DANCE.about: This dance, characterized by spins, improvised moves, cartwheels, and jumps grants the dancer and his or her party a high degree of protection from various unnatural things, such as acid, cold,…

DANCE.name: Macabre
DANCE.about: This European dance from the middle ages, characterized by skeletons playing instruments, gives the dancer and his or her party bonus attack and damage, especially when hidden.

DANCE.name: Manipuri
DANCE.about: This soft, religious dance from India will preserve peace for the dancer and his or her party by preventing aggression against them for a period of time after entering a new place.

DANCE.name: Morris
DANCE.about: This English ceremonial dance, characterized by ringing bells on the dancers feet, will cause the dancers enemies to become highly distracted during combat.

DANCE.name: Musette
DANCE.about: This slow moving dance, usually done to a bass drone, will cut the attacks of the dancers enemies in half.

DANCE.name: Polka
DANCE.about: This quick dance, popular in German drinking and dancing halls, will inebriate the dancers enemies.

DANCE.name: Rags Sharqi
DANCE.about: Also known as the Belly dance, this Egyptian dance will grant the dancer and his or her party bonus hit points and a small resistance to disease.

DANCE.name: Salsa
DANCE.about: This sensuous cuban dancing style grants the dancer and his or her party bonus to Charisma, and a very romantic mood.

DANCE.name: Square
DANCE.about: This American couple dance, where moves are usually called out by a singer, causes all who hear and witness the dancer to follow his or her commands whenever they are spoken by a dancer of…

DANCE.name: Stop
DANCE.about: This causes the dancer to stop dancing.

DANCE.name: Swing
DANCE.about: This highly social and flamboyant dancing style grants the dancer and his or her party parrying abilities, both armed and unarmed.

DANCE.name: Swords
DANCE.about: This mystical and magical dance, related to the Indian snake charm, will cause any swords on the ground to rise up and attack the dancer's enemies.

DANCE.name: Tango
DANCE.about: This highly beautiful and sensual dancing style from Argentina gives the dancer and his or her party members a huge bonus to Charisma.

DANCE.name: Tap
DANCE.about: This American percussive dance, characterized by rapid and tiring foot tapping will tire out the dancers enemies, taking away their mana as well.

DANCE.name: Tarantella
DANCE.about: This Italian folk dance, whose origin comes from a belief that the dance would sweat out a spider's poison, protects the dancer and his or her party from poison, as well as removing poison every…

DANCE.name: Waltz
DANCE.about: This dance in 3/4 time gives 3 points to a random ability score for the dancer and his or her party.

DANCE.name: War
DANCE.about: This Native American dance grants the dancer and his or her party members a huge bonus to attack, damage, and armor, as well as bonus to their stats, all at the expense of Mana.

PLAY.name: Accompaniment
PLAY.about: This tune will grant extra levels to any OTHER bards in the playing-bard`s group.

PLAY.name: Background
PLAY.about: This tune will grant bonuses to all saving throws for all members of the bard`s group.

PLAY.name: Ballad
PLAY.about: This tune inspires the bard and his or her group to better attacking, and better resistance to mind attacks.

PLAY.name: Battlehymn
PLAY.about: This song will grant the bard and the bard`s group a bonus to their damage during combat.

PLAY.name: Blues
PLAY.about: This tune affects the enemies of the bard.

PLAY.name: Break
PLAY.about: This causes the bard to stop playing his or her instrument.

PLAY.name: Carol
PLAY.about: This song increases the bard and the bard`s groups defence against mind based attacks.

PLAY.name: Charge!
PLAY.about: This song will cause the bard and the bard`s group to charge the target, giving them a bonus to attack and damage, at the expense of some defence.

PLAY.name: Clarinets
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of clarinet-like instruments.

PLAY.name: Cymbals
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of cymbal-like instruments.

PLAY.name: Dirge
PLAY.about: This song will cause any dead bodys in the room to fade away, which will also give the bard and the bard`s group a little extra experience.

PLAY.name: Ditty
PLAY.about: While this song is playing, the bard and the bard`s group will all gain back hit points at an accelerated rate.

PLAY.name: Drums
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of drum-like instruments.

PLAY.name: Flutes
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of flute-like instruments.

PLAY.name: Guitars
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of guitar-like instruments.

PLAY.name: Harmonicas
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of harmonica-like instruments.

PLAY.name: Harmony
PLAY.about: This song produces a calming affect for the bard and the bard`s group.

PLAY.name: Harps
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of harp-like instruments.

PLAY.name: Horns
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of horn-like instruments.

PLAY.name: Instruments
PLAY.about: This skill allows a player to attempt to play a musical instrument they are holding or prepared to use.

PLAY.name: Love Song
PLAY.about: This song increases the charisma of the bard and the bard`s group.

PLAY.name: Lullabies
PLAY.about: This song puts to sleep all enemies of the bard.

PLAY.name: March
PLAY.about: This song allows movement to be quickly regenerated for the bard and the bard`s group.

PLAY.name: Melody
PLAY.about: This song makes all enemies of the bard more susceptible to mind-based attacks.

PLAY.name: Mystical
PLAY.about: This song is a tremendous benefit to all spell and spell-like affects.

PLAY.name: Oboes
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of oboe-like instruments.

PLAY.name: Organs
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of organ-like instruments.

PLAY.name: Pianos
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of piano-like instruments.

PLAY.name: Retreat
PLAY.about: This song will cause the bard and all of his or her group to retreat in the direction specified, in an orderly fashion.

PLAY.name: Reveille
PLAY.about: This song wakes up everyone in the room, and all adjacent rooms.

PLAY.name: Rhythm
PLAY.about: This song decreases the magical resistance of all enemies of the bard.

PLAY.name: Solo
PLAY.about: This song will instantly stop all other bard songs in the room, including dances, instruments, and other songs.

PLAY.name: Spiritual
PLAY.about: This song is a tremendous benefit to all prayer and prayer-like affects.

PLAY.name: Symphony
PLAY.about: This extremely versatile song has a different affect for every single instrument that exists, and can change depending on the level of the instrument.

PLAY.name: Tempo
PLAY.about: This song causes the common skills of the bard and the bard`s group to be completed more quickly.

PLAY.name: Tribal
PLAY.about: This song is a tremendous benefit to all chant and chant-like affects.

PLAY.name: Trombones
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of trombone-like instruments.

PLAY.name: Trumpets
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of trumpet-like instruments.

PLAY.name: Tubas
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of tuba-like instruments.

PLAY.name: Violins
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of violin-like instruments.

PLAY.name: Wood Clappers
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of wood-clapping instruments.

PLAY.name: Xylophones
PLAY.about: This song brings out the magical abilities of all kinds of xylophone-like instruments.

SING.name: Armor
SING.about: The bards and the bard`s group become harder to hit in combat.

SING.name: Awareness
SING.about: Allows the bard and the bard`s group to detect magical items and creatures.

SING.name: Babble
SING.about: Anyone not in the bard`s group will begin to speak unintelligibly.

SING.name: Blasting
SING.about: Improves the damage ability of the bard and the bard`s group.

SING.name: Clumsiness
SING.about: Enemies of the bard lose some of their dexterity, and become easier to hit in combat.

SING.name: Comprehension
SING.about: Allows the bard and the bard`s group to understand any language being spoken.

SING.name: Death
SING.about: Deals deadly blows to all enemies hearing the bard.

SING.name: Dexterity
SING.about: The bard can sing away some of his or her dexterity, granting the bonus to members of the bard`s group.

SING.name: Disgust
SING.about: Non-combatant enemies who aren't too powerful, upon hearing the bard, will become disgusted, attacking someone else in the room at random.

SING.name: Distraction
SING.about: Enemies of the bard will become distracted during combat, forgetting to make their attacks from time to time.

SING.name: Enchant Instrument
SING.about: This song allows the bard to place any song/dance he or she knows onto an empty magical music instrument.

SING.name: Flight
SING.about: Allows the bard and the bard`s group to flee combat without experience penalty.

SING.name: Flying
SING.about: Allows the bard and the bard`s group to fly.

SING.name: Friendship
SING.about: Has a powerful charming effect on all bard enemies hearing the song.

SING.name: Health
SING.about: Grants to the bard and members of the bard`s group hearing the song bonus maximum hit points, which must be healed to use.

SING.name: Knowledge
SING.about: The bards and the bard`s group gain two points of intelligence and wisdom.

SING.name: Lethargy
SING.about: Enemies of the bard who hear this song move more slowly, cutting in half their number of attacks.

SING.name: Lightness
SING.about: Friends of the bard who hear this song to become light as a feather, able to fall from high places without taking damage.

SING.name: Lullaby
SING.about: Enemies of the bard who hear this song fall fast asleep.

SING.name: Mana
SING.about: The bards and the bard`s group regains mana more quickly.

SING.name: Mercy
SING.about: The bards and the bard`s group gain a short rest from the attacks of aggressive monsters whenever entering a new room or place.

SING.name: Muting
SING.about: Enemies of the bard who hear this song find themselves unable to speak, sing, pray, or cast verbal spells.

SING.name: Nothing
SING.about: Causes the bard to stop singing.

SING.name: Ode
SING.about: This song allows the bard to either compose an ode about a player or monster which is present, or sing an ode already composed.

SING.name: Pirate Shanty
SING.about: The singer and their group regains movement and loses fatigue while the song is being sung in the same room.

SING.name: Protection
SING.about: The bards and the bard`s group gain an invulnerability to certain magical and elemental affects, and become harder to hit, at the expense of a little dexterity.

SING.name: Quickness
SING.about: The bards and the bard`s group begin to move more quickly, gaining one additional attack per round.

SING.name: Rage
SING.about: Enemies of the bard who hear this song become enraged, doing more damage in combat, but hitting less often, and being more easily hit.

SING.name: Read Music
SING.about: This song is required in order to be able to invoke songs off of scrolls.

SING.name: Rebirth
SING.about: The dead, cold bodies of any players in the same room as the bard are resusitated.

SING.name: Recharge Instrument
SING.about: This song allows the caster to recharge the magical properties of a magic wand-like musical instrument.

SING.name: Restore Music
SING.about: When sung over a magical song scroll, the notation on the paper gain new clarity.

SING.name: Revelation
SING.about: The bards and the bard`s group gain the ability to see in the dark, as well as to see invisible things and creatures.

SING.name: Saudade
SING.about: Invoking strong feelings of one`s home, the song of Saudade can overcome many supernatural barriers to return one away to the singers home.

SING.name: Seeing
SING.about: The bards and the bard`s group gain the ability to see hidden and sneaking creatures, as well as infravision, or the ability to see non-undead creatures in the dark.

SING.name: Serenity
SING.about: Enemies hearing the bard immediately cease combat, and gain a suddenly peaceful nature.

SING.name: Silencing
SING.about: Enemies of the bard who hear this song find themselves unable to speak, sing, pray, hear sounds, or cast verbal spells

SING.name: Single Mindedness
SING.about: Enemies of the bard who hear this song find themselves unable perform any action except for the first action they perform when this song starts.

SING.name: Strength
SING.about: The bard can sing away some of his or her strength, granting the bonus to members of the bard`s group.

SING.name: Suave
SING.about: Improves the Charisma of the bard and the bard`s group.

SING.name: Thanks
SING.about: Non-monster enemies of the bard who hear this song may be inspired to give a coin to the bard, with thanks.

SING.name: Valor
SING.about: The bards and the bard`s group become more proficient with their weapons, and gain more attack skill.

CAST.name: Achilles Armor
CAST.about: This spell creates an almost impenetrable field around the willing target.

CAST.name: Acid Arrow
CAST.about: This spell will conjure up an arrow of acid, which will hit and splash upon the target, doing additional acid damage each round.

CAST.name: Acid Fog
CAST.about: Causes a powerful horrendous cloud of burning acid to descend upon the casters enemies.

CAST.name: Acid Spray
CAST.about: The caster conjures a spray of acid that assaults the target.

CAST.name: Add Limb
CAST.about: This spell causes the target to grow a third arm, allowing them to wear additional rings, or hold additional items.

CAST.name: Advancement
CAST.about: Increases the level, temporarily, of the target, by one.

CAST.name: Alarm
CAST.about: This spell can be cast on any object sitting in the room.

CAST.name: Alter Substance
CAST.about: The caster causes the target item to temporarily take on a new substance.

CAST.name: Alternate Reality
CAST.about: Drawing on the frenzy of combat, the mage is able to convince the target that his or her enemies are really friends and vis-versa.

CAST.name: Analyze Item
CAST.about: This spell gives the caster a sense of an items material type and other classifications, as well as any magical or other effects.

CAST.name: Anchor
CAST.about: This spell allows the target to become immune to summoning and gate spells.

CAST.name: Animate Item
examples: cast "animate item" sword glows with a blinding power.
CAST.about: This spell causes the item to immediately animate in the way denoted by the emote string.

CAST.name: Animate Weapon
CAST.about: This spell can be cast on any weapon.

CAST.name: Anti Plant Shell
CAST.about: This spell creates a force field around the target into which an aggressive plant may not advance.

CAST.name: Arcane Mark
examples: cast "arcane mark" gloves "these are my gloves"
CAST.about: This spell will scribe a magical marking upon the specified item.

CAST.name: Arcane Possession
CAST.about: This spell will zap anyone who tries to wear, hold, or wield the item other than the owner.

CAST.name: Arms Length
CAST.about: This spell gives the caster a predictive warning whenever their opponent in combat is about to advance on them, allowing the caster to retreat before they do.

CAST.name: Astral Step
CAST.about: This spell allows the caster to pass through doors by going through the astral plane of existence.

CAST.name: Augury
CAST.about: This spell divines the wisdom of travelling in a particular direction.

CAST.name: Awe
CAST.about: This spell allows the caster to become so awe-inspiring that there's a chance lower level aggressive creatures won't initiate combat against him or her, though they can, of course, fight back.

CAST.name: Awe Other
CAST.about: This spell forces the target to become in awe of whoever the caster wishes.

CAST.name: Big Mouth
CAST.about: This spell causes the caster's mouth to grow to an enormous size, allowing the caster to EAT any creature that is half his weight or smaller.

CAST.name: Blademouth
CAST.about: If successful, this spell causes the target`s mouth to be filled with blades.

CAST.name: Blind
CAST.about: If successful, this spell makes the target blind.

CAST.name: Blink
CAST.about: If successful, this spell makes the target begin to vanish and reappear nearby, possibly putting him or her in and out of range of missile or melee weapons.

CAST.name: Blur
CAST.about: This spell causes the target to go out of focus.

CAST.name: Brainwash
examples: cast brainwash orc I am a jelly donut.
CAST.about: This spell causes the target to so fully believe the message given that they will repeat it whenever they talk to anyone else.

CAST.name: Breadcrumbs
CAST.about: Allows the caster to remain aware of the trail from the room he or she started in to the room in which he or she presently stands.

CAST.name: Burning Hands
CAST.about: A fan of flames ignite before the casters hands, aimed at the target.

CAST.name: Cause Stink
CAST.about: This spell makes the target smell really really bad.

CAST.name: Chain Lightning
CAST.about: This spell causes a huge, branching arch of electricity to jump from person to person in the room until it is spent.

CAST.name: Change Sex
CAST.about: Changes the sex of the target temporarily.

CAST.name: Channeled Missiles
CAST.about: The caster begins channeling painful flashes of magical energy towards the target.

CAST.name: Chant Shield
CAST.about: This spell allows the target to become almost immune to Druidic chants.

CAST.name: Charm
CAST.about: Causes the target to view the caster as a loyal ally and friend.

CAST.name: Charm Ward
CAST.about: Causes the target to become protected from the affects of charming.

CAST.name: Choke
CAST.about: The target becomes unable to breathe, and begins to suffocate!

CAST.name: Claireaudience
CAST.about: Causes the target to echo everything they say into the ears of the caster, allowing the caster to know everything the target says.

CAST.name: Clairevoyance
CAST.about: This spell allows the caster to see everything which the target actively looks at, including all new rooms the target enters.

CAST.name: Clan Donate
CAST.about: When cast on an item, this spell will send it to the room designated by the casters clan boss as the donation room.

CAST.name: Clan Experience
CAST.about: This spell drains an amount of experience from the caster and grants it to their clan, or the specified clan if they belong to more than one.

CAST.name: Clan Home
CAST.about: This spell sends the caster back to the room designated by the casters clan boss as the home room.

CAST.name: Clan Ward
CAST.about: This spell must be used in a room that is owned by the casters clan.

CAST.name: ClanEnchant Acid
CAST.about: When cast on an item, this spell will use up some of the clan's experience (how much depends on power put into the casting) to magically enhance the item with ACID magic.

CAST.name: ClanEnchant Cold
CAST.about: When cast on an item, this spell will use up some of the clan's experience (how much depends on power put into the casting) to magically enhance the item with COLD magic.

CAST.name: ClanEnchant Disease
CAST.about: When cast on an item, this spell will use up some of the clan's experience (how much depends on power put into the casting) to magically enhance the item with DISEASE damaging blasts, and disease…

CAST.name: ClanEnchant Electric
CAST.about: When cast on an item, this spell will use up some of the clan's experience (how much depends on power put into the casting) to magically enhance the item with ELECTRIC magic.

CAST.name: ClanEnchant Fire
CAST.about: When cast on an item, this spell will use up some of the clan's experience (how much depends on power put into the casting) to magically enhance the item with FIRE magic.

CAST.name: ClanEnchant Gas
CAST.about: When cast on an item, this spell will use up some of the clan's experience (how much depends on power put into the casting) to magically enhance the item with GAS magic.

CAST.name: ClanEnchant Mind
CAST.about: When cast on an item, this spell will use up some of the clan's experience (how much depends on power put into the casting) to magically enhance the item with MIND damaging blasts, and resistances.

CAST.name: ClanEnchant Paralysis
CAST.about: When cast on an item, this spell will use up some of the clan's experience (how much depends on power put into the casting) to magically enhance the item with PARALYSIS damaging blasts, and…

CAST.name: ClanEnchant Poison
CAST.about: When cast on an item, this spell will use up some of the clan's experience (how much depends on power put into the casting) to magically enhance the item with POISON damaging blasts, and resistances.

CAST.name: ClanEnchant Water
CAST.about: When cast on an item, this spell will use up some of the clan's experience (how much depends on power put into the casting) to magically enhance the item with WATER magic.

CAST.name: Clarify Scroll
CAST.about: When cast on a magical scroll, the letters and symbols on the paper gain new clarity.

CAST.name: Clog Mouth
CAST.about: This spell causes the target`s mouth to become clogged with gunk.

CAST.name: Clone
CAST.about: This spell causes the caster to split into two different but identical people.

CAST.name: Cloudkill
CAST.about: Causes an evil, murderous cloud to form over all of the enemies of the caster.

CAST.name: Cogniportive
CAST.about: This spell causes the target item to create a mystical link with the place of its origin.

CAST.name: Color Spray
CAST.about: The caster sprays forth a huge cone of flashing lights and colors into the eyes of his or her enemies.

CAST.name: Combat Precognition
CAST.about: This powerful spell allows the caster to see attacks against him or her before they happen, and in many cases, to react to avoid them.

CAST.name: Command
examples: cast command orc give sword bob
CAST.about: This spell forces the target to perform some task for the caster.

CAST.name: Comprehend Languages
CAST.about: This spell allows the caster to understand any spoken language, but not to speak it, or interact with shopkeepers in it.

CAST.name: Confusion
CAST.about: This spell causes the target become confused during combat, which may cause him or her to attack a different target, or no target, spontaneously.

CAST.name: Conjure Ammunition
CAST.about: This spell conjures ammunition appropriate to the target item or person.

CAST.name: Conjure Nexus
CAST.about: This spell summons the great Nexus of Mana to the room in which this spell is cast.

CAST.name: Continual Light
CAST.about: This spell evokes a bright light into the target item or above the target mob.

CAST.name: Counterspell
CAST.about: This spell allows the target to resist or be immune to the very next arcane spell cast at him or her.

CAST.name: Darkness
CAST.about: Causes a pitch-black darkness to fill the room.

CAST.name: Darkness Globe
CAST.about: Causes an enormous globe of darkness to follow the caster around, enveloping everyone in the room, and making the room as dark as a moonless night whereever the caster is.

CAST.name: Daydream
CAST.about: This spell allows the caster to implant a daydream into the mind of all awake but idle players.

CAST.name: Deaden Smell
CAST.about: This spell makes the target unable to smell anything.

CAST.name: Deafen
CAST.about: Causes the target to become deaf, unable to hear anything.

CAST.name: Death Warning
CAST.about: Upon casting this spell, the caster becomes sensitive to prophetic warnings of his or her death.

CAST.name: Deflection
CAST.about: This spell will cause a ward to surround the target, deflecting a ranged attack off target before dissipating.

CAST.name: Delay
CAST.about: Allows the caster to cast a spell on a delayed basis.

CAST.name: Delirium
CAST.about: This spell causes the target to become very confused about who is actually doing or saying what around them.

CAST.name: Delude
CAST.about: Causes the attitudes of the caster to change dramatically.

CAST.name: Demon Gate
CAST.about: This spell will conjure up a hideous demon from the depths of the abyss.

CAST.name: Destroy Object
CAST.about: Causes the target object to vanish into oblivion.

CAST.name: Detect Ambush
CAST.about: Allows the caster to sense hidden and aggressive creatures as they wander around, before they actually enter.

CAST.name: Detect Bombs
CAST.about: This spell gives the caster a sense of whether there are any bombs in the room.

CAST.name: Detect Gold
CAST.about: Allows the caster to sense the emanations coming from gold coins all around.

CAST.name: Detect Hidden
CAST.about: Allows the caster to see hidden creatures and objects.

CAST.name: Detect Invisible
CAST.about: Allows the caster to see invisible creatures and objects.

CAST.name: Detect Magic
CAST.about: Allows the caster to tell magical objects and creatures from mundane ones.

CAST.name: Detect Metal
CAST.about: Allows the caster to sense metal vibrations (including those from mithril or gold) coming from items the caster sees.

CAST.name: Detect Poison
CAST.about: Allows the caster to sense poison in a creature or item.

CAST.name: Detect Scrying
CAST.about: This spell gives the caster a sense of whether anyone is watching or listening to the target magically.

CAST.name: Detect Sentience
CAST.about: Allows the caster to detect the whereabouts of all sentient beings in the same area of the caster.

CAST.name: Detect Traps
CAST.about: This spell gives the caster a sense of whether there are any traps in the room.

CAST.name: Detect Undead
CAST.about: Allows the caster to detect the cold dark hearts of the undead.

CAST.name: Detect Water
CAST.about: Allows the caster to smell water sources all around.

CAST.name: Detect Weaknesses
CAST.about: The caster gains important tactical knowledge about the weaknesses of his or her current combat opponent, gaining bonuses to both attack and damage against that target.

CAST.name: Detonate Bombs
CAST.about: This spell causes any bombs set by the caster to instantly explode on the nearest target.

CAST.name: Disenchant Item
CAST.about: Objects affected by enchantments can be brought back to mundane status by this spell, including wands, potions, pills, and weapons/armor enchanted using the spells Enchant Armor or Enchant Weapon.

CAST.name: Disenchant Wand
CAST.about: Wands are rendered into useless lumps by this spell.

CAST.name: Disguise Other
CAST.about: This spell allows the caster to disguise the target as the given mob for a short time.

CAST.name: Disguise Self
CAST.about: This spell allows the caster to disguise him or herself as the given mob for a short time.

CAST.name: Disguise Undead
CAST.about: This spell makes the target undead creature appear to be an average human joe, and eliminates any nasty smell emotes.

CAST.name: Disintegrate
CAST.about: If this spell is successful, the target is completely disintegrated and destroyed.

CAST.name: Dismissal
CAST.about: If successful, this spell conjurs the target back to its "home" room.

CAST.name: Dispel Divination
CAST.about: This spell can be cast on any object or creature affected by any divination spell.

CAST.name: Dispel Magic
CAST.about: This spell can be cast on any object or creature affected by any arcane (Mage) spell.

CAST.name: Distant Vision
CAST.about: Allows the caster to "see" the place specified by the spell.

CAST.name: Divination Ward
CAST.about: Causes the target to become protected from divination magic.

CAST.name: Divine Beauty
CAST.about: This spell causes the target to become the most perfectly beautiful and confident-seeming incarnation of their present form.

CAST.name: Divining Eye
CAST.about: This spell requires the prior use of the spell "prying eye".

CAST.name: Dragonfire
CAST.about: Blasting flames burst from the mouth of the caster, scorching any and all enemies in the same room.

CAST.name: Dream
CAST.usage: CAST "DREAM" [DREAM TO GIVE TO ALL SLEEPING]
CAST.about: This spell allows the caster to implant a dream into the mind of all sleeping players and monsters.

CAST.name: Duplicate
CAST.about: The caster causes the target item to split and become two identical items which are the same as the original.

CAST.name: Earthquake
CAST.about: This spell causes the ground to shake and rumble under the feet of all enemies of the caster in the same room.

CAST.name: Elemental Storm
CAST.about: This spell causes a shower of different elemental attacks to assault the target.

CAST.name: Enchant Armor
CAST.about: This spell causes any piece of armor to become permanently enchanted.

CAST.name: Enchant Arrows
CAST.about: This spell causes a single bundle of arrows to become permanently enchanted.

CAST.name: Enchant Wand
CAST.about: This spell allows the caster to place any spell he or she knows onto an empty wand.

CAST.name: Enchant Weapon
CAST.about: This spell causes any weapon to become permanently enchanted.

CAST.name: Endless Hunger
CAST.about: The target of this spell becomes extremely hungry, for the duration of the spell.

CAST.name: Endless Road
CAST.about: This spell causes the target to become confused about which way he or she is actually going.

CAST.name: Enlarge Object
CAST.about: This spell causes an object to become temporarily enormous.

CAST.name: Enlightenment
CAST.about: This spell grants the target increased intelligence.

CAST.name: Ensnare
CAST.about: This spell will cause the feet of every enemy of the caster in the same room to become ensnared in magical energy.

CAST.name: Enthrall
CAST.about: Causes the target to view the caster as a loyal ally and friend.

CAST.name: Erase Scroll
CAST.about: This spell removes the markings on any target object containing writing.

CAST.name: Exhaustion
CAST.about: This spell causes the target to suffer immediate fatigue.

CAST.name: Fabricate
CAST.about: The caster causes the target item to temporarily materialize in his or her hands.

CAST.name: Faerie Fire
CAST.about: This spell causes a bright purple aura to surround the target.

CAST.name: Faerie Fog
CAST.about: A misty purple fog fills the area around the caster.

CAST.name: Fake Armor
CAST.about: This spell creates a piece of armor of the material and type specified by the caster.

CAST.name: Fake Food
CAST.about: This spell creates a few pieces of a random bit of food.

CAST.name: Fake Spring
CAST.about: This spell creates an illusionary spring.

CAST.name: Fake Weapon
CAST.about: This spell creates a weapon specified by the caster, which appears perfectly normal, and will seem to do massive damage during combat, but which actually does no damage.

CAST.name: Farsight
CAST.about: This spell allows the caster to see the contents of any room or area adjacent to the caster.

CAST.name: Fatigue
CAST.about: This spell causes the target to become fatigued.

CAST.name: Fear
CAST.about: This spell causes all of the casters enemies to flee before him or her.

CAST.name: Feather Fall
CAST.about: This spell causes the target to become as light as a feather.

CAST.name: Feeblemind
CAST.about: This spell causes the target to become utterly stupid.

CAST.name: Feel The Void
CAST.about: This spell will convince the target that they are completely deprived of sight, hearing, smell, touch, and taste.

CAST.name: Feign Death
CAST.about: This spell causes the target to become invisible.

CAST.name: Feign Invisibility
CAST.about: Casting this spell will cause the target to think that he/she is under the effects of an improved invisibility spell.

CAST.name: Find Directions
CAST.about: Provided the caster is not too far away, this spell will cause travelling directions to the given area to appear in his or her mind.

CAST.name: Find Familiar
CAST.about: This spell will conjure up a "pet" for the caster with specific powers.

CAST.name: Find Planar Familiar
CAST.about: This spell will conjure up a "pet" for the caster with specific powers based on either the players current plane, or a random plane.

CAST.name: Fireball
CAST.about: This spell creates a flaming ball of fire to shoot from the casters hand towards the target.

CAST.name: Flagportation
CAST.about: This spell will teleport the caster and his or her group to a random clan flag on the map.

CAST.name: Flameshield
CAST.about: This spell evokes a flaming field to surround the target.

CAST.name: Flaming Arrows
CAST.about: Causes the targeted arrows to turn into pointed shafts of burning hot coal that do extra burning damage on hit.

CAST.name: Flaming Ensnarement
CAST.about: This spell will cause the feet of every enemy of the caster in the same room to become ensnared in flaming tentacles erupting from the ground.

CAST.name: Flaming Sword
CAST.about: This spell conjures a sword enveloping flame to surround the target sword.

CAST.name: Flesh Stone
CAST.about: This spell turns the target into a great stone statue.

CAST.name: Floating Disc
CAST.about: The target of this spell is any object which the caster does not wish to carry around.

CAST.name: Fly
CAST.about: This spell causes the target`s feet to leave the ground.

CAST.name: Fools Gold
CAST.about: This spell creates a pile of gold in the amount specified.

CAST.name: Forceful Hand
CAST.about: During combat, this spell creates a floating hand that pushes back the casters target enemy and holds them back for a short time.

CAST.name: Forecast Weather
CAST.about: For the duration of the spell, the caster is able to accurately predict the next weather conditions for a given area, so long as the caster is outside.

CAST.name: Forget
CAST.about: Causes the target to spontaneously forget abilities, spells, songs, or prayers for the duration of the spell.

CAST.name: Forked Lightning
CAST.about: This spell causes a huge, branching arch of electricity to strike all enemies in the same room as the caster.

CAST.name: Frailty
CAST.about: Causes the target take double damage from all physical sources, for the duration of the spell.

CAST.name: Free Movement
CAST.about: This spell allows the target to become immune to spells which would hold or prevent movement.

CAST.name: Frenzy
CAST.about: This spell causes the target to enter a state of blind combative frenzy.

CAST.name: Friends
CAST.about: The target of this spell will seem more charismatic and attractive, even to shopkeepers.

CAST.name: Frost
CAST.about: This spell causes a burning blast of frost to assault the target.

CAST.name: Future Death
CAST.about: The caster causes the target to see the manner in which he or she will die at some point in the future.

CAST.name: Gate
CAST.about: This spell requires the name of some creature in the world.
